name: ship_run
description: Ship a finished swarm run: push its result branch to the remote and open a pull request into the base branch (an existing pull request for the branch is reused and its summary updated). Started from the console's or TUI's Open pull request action.

repoPath.description: The repository the run delivered into (the run's sourceRepoPath), where its branch lives.

branch.description: The run's result branch to push and open the pull request from.

base.description: The branch the pull request merges into. Empty uses the repository's default branch.

title.description: The pull request title: what the run was asked to do.

summary.description: One paragraph describing the change; pr_create writes it as the body's single Summary section (at most 500 characters).

draft.description: Open the pull request as a draft.

remote.description: The git remote to push the branch to.

modelProfile.description: Named model profile to resolve; empty string defers to the policy's default profile.

modelPolicy.description: Inline model policy document (or JSON string) merged on top of the bundled and repository policies.

modelPolicySource.description: Provenance label recorded for the inline modelPolicy.

modelPolicySha256.description: Expected canonical SHA-256 of the inline modelPolicy.

modelsConfig.description: Relative path (inside the worktree) to a repository model policy file, overriding the default location.

modelOverrides.description: Per-role model overrides (or a JSON string of the same) merged on top of the selected profile.

head.description: The commit the branch must still point at: what the human saw on the result card. The push is refused if the branch moved since.
